author: ChinaDaily
name: China Daily
text: Welcome the New Year with the radiant glow of Dashuhua in Yuxian county, Hebei province in northern China. This centuries-old spectacle of molten sparks, a treasure of Chinese intangible cultural heritage, light up the winter night with wishes and blessings, ushering in a year brimming with fortune and joy. #CulturalJourney
